children: American Airlines launched its first Boeing 777-300ER with a reconfigured premium seating setup.
The plane has the most premium seats on an aircraft operated by any U.S. carrier, the airline said Wednesday.
American's Boeing 777-300ER fleet of 20 aircraft operates on the airline's most trafficked long-haul routes to London; Tokyo; Sao Paulo, Brazil; Buenos Aires, Argentina; and Sydney, Australia.
The first flight with the new planes leaves Wednesday from New York to Buenos Aires.
The aircraft includes 144 premium seats with 70 Flagship Suite seats, which feature privacy doors, more personal storage space and a chaise lounge seating position.
There also are 44 Premium Economy seats that are redesigned with sculpted headrests, adjustable calf and foot rests, and enhanced storage. There are 30 extra-legroom seats in Main Cabin Extra.
The new design comes as airlines are spending more on premium offerings to capitalize on wealthy consumers who travel the most.
